description: Edit server settings: name, description, AFK behavior, system and rules channels, verification level. Only passed fields change. Descriptions need a Community server.

afk_channel.description: Voice channel name or ID, or none to clear.

community.description: Enable or disable the Community feature. Enabling needs rules_channel and public_updates_channel.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

public_updates_channel.description: Text channel for Discord's mod updates, when enabling Community.

rules_channel.description: Text channel for the rules, when enabling Community.

system_channel.description: Channel for join notices, or none to clear.

name: update_server
title: Update server
